boards.title: Your First Weekend at Loras College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence combining documented Loras first-year activities, recognizable campus landmarks, and under-21-safe Dubuque destinations.

cards.title: Begin Where Duhawks Ring the Bell
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · a documented first-year ritual
cards.notes: Take a first-weekend photo at the bell, echoing the documented ritual students repeat at the end of their Loras careers.
cards.short_summary: Mark the beginning of college with a school-specific bell tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras documents that students ring the bell at the beginning and again at the end of their college careers.
cards.source_title: Launch Into Loras | Welcome to Your New Home
cards.access_notes: Confirm the bell's location and availability on campus before planning the photo.

cards.title: Meet Up on the MARC Lawn
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · outdoor campus gathering point
cards.notes: Use the lawn as an easy group rendezvous; Loras schedules cookouts, pizza gatherings, water games, bingo, and lawn games here.
cards.short_summary: Start the social part of the weekend at a documented campus activity lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras schedules multiple first-year and weekend activities on MARC Lawn, including a welcome cookout, Pizzapalooza, water games, bingo, and lawn games.
cards.source_title: Launch Into Loras | Welcome to Your New Home
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use is weather-dependent; follow campus instructions when an organized program occupies the lawn.

cards.title: Learn the Alumni Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · practical campus hub
cards.notes: Locate the post office, health and counseling, IT help, dining, Marketplace, student-life offices, and Campus Safety in one pass.
cards.short_summary: Orient yourself to the campus services concentrated inside the ACC.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras identifies the Alumni Campus Center as the home of the post office, health and counseling, IT help desk, dining, Marketplace, student-life offices, and Campus Safety.
cards.access_notes: Building and service access may vary by academic calendar; bring a student ID when campus services require it.

cards.title: Find the Rock Bowl Before Game Day
cards.subtitle: Friday night · landmark stadium stop
cards.notes: Walk over before dark to recognize the stadium layout; Loras uses the Rock Bowl for welcome ceremonies, soccer, and football.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with a prominent athletics and orientation venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras lists Rock Bowl Stadium on its campus map and documents welcome ceremonies, soccer matches, and football games at the venue.
cards.source_title: Campus Map and Directions | Loras College
cards.access_notes: Spectator entry depends on the scheduled event; use the athletics or college calendar before entering venue areas.

cards.title: Start Saturday at Washington Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · named downtown park
cards.notes: Use this map-listed downtown park as a visible meeting point before exploring nearby streets, public art, and local businesses.
cards.short_summary: Choose a recognizable civic landmark for the downtown portion of the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Dubuque lists Washington Park at 700 Locust Street among its featured parks and facilities.
cards.source_title: City Services Guide: Living in Dubuque
cards.access_notes: This is a public city park; observe posted park rules and any temporary event restrictions.

cards.title: Spend Saturday with River History
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · museum and aquarium visit
cards.notes: Allow a substantial daytime block for the exhibits, and bring a current college ID if you plan to request the listed student rate.
cards.short_summary: Connect Dubuque’s riverfront setting with regional ecology and history.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum currently operates daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. in its summer/fall season and lists a discounted admission rate for college students with school ID.
cards.source_title: Buy Tickets | National Mississippi River Museum & Aquarium
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours are 9 a.m.–5 p.m. daily; admission is required, and the college discount is available only at the box office.

cards.title: Follow the Riverwalk Art Route
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · riverfront walking stop
cards.notes: Walk from the museum area toward the Star Brewery side, pausing at the rotating sculptures and Mississippi River viewpoints.
cards.short_summary: Pair an outdoor river view with Dubuque’s changing public-art exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: Dubuque’s Art on the River exhibition places eleven rotating sculptures along the Mississippi Riverwalk between the Star Brewery and river museum area.
cards.source_title: Art on the River | Dubuque, IA - Official Website
cards.access_notes: The city recommends viewing the sculptures from sunrise to sunset; the route accommodates pedestrians and mobility aids.

cards.title: Catch the View at Eagle Point Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · seasonal scenic overlook
cards.notes: Arrive before closing for views over the Mississippi and Lock and Dam No. 11; enter on foot or bicycle to avoid the vehicle fee.
cards.short_summary: Close Saturday at a named city park overlooking three states.
cards.evidence_claim: The city states that Eagle Point Park overlooks the Mississippi River and Lock and Dam No. 11; pedestrians and bicycles enter free.
cards.source_title: Eagle Point Park | Dubuque, IA - Official Website
cards.access_notes: Seasonal hours are 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday and Saturday through October 25, 2026; vehicle admission is $1 per car.

cards.title: Take a Sunday Garden Walk
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · no-admission outdoor activity
cards.notes: Follow the Legacy Tree Trail, Conifer Trail, or StoryWalk; expect a mix of gravel, dirt, woodchip, grass, and accessible paths.
cards.short_summary: Reset on Sunday with a self-paced walk through named garden trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum states that its grounds are open daily from 7 a.m. to dusk with no admission fee and describes its walking surfaces and named trails.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open daily from 7 a.m. to dusk; select a route compatible with weather and your preferred surface.

cards.title: Return to Christ the King Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · reflective campus finish
cards.notes: End the loop at a defining campus landmark; Loras documents an 8 p.m. Sunday College Mass during Labor Stay Weekend.
cards.short_summary: Finish the first-weekend sequence at a documented Loras worship venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Loras identifies Christ the King Chapel as a worship and music-ministry venue and schedules Loras College Mass there during Labor Stay Weekend.
cards.access_notes: The cited 8 p.m. Mass is scheduled for September 6, 2026; consult the current worship schedule on other weekends.
